description.zh: 主播ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The anchor ID. Supports only letters and digits with a maximum length of 36 characters.

description.zh: 主播昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32位。
description.en: The anchor nickname. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 32 characters.

description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 直播封面，支持图片地址链接格式，最大长度256位。
description.en: The cover image of the live room. Specify the value as an image URL with a maximum length of 256 characters.

description.zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的房间属性。
description.en: The extension field. Pass as needed to record additional room properties.
The unique ID of the live room.

description.zh: 直播公告，支持中英文，最大长度256位。
description.en: The live room announcement. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 256 characters.

description.zh: 直播标题，支持中英文，最大长度32位。
description.en: The live room title. Supports Chinese and English characters with a maximum length of 32 characters.

description.zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The operator ID. Supports only letters and digits with a maximum length of 36 characters.
